contentList.content: When you damage a creature with a proficient Handaxe, Rapier, Shortsword, Shortbow, or Hand Crossbow, you gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn.
The creature that applied Vex has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on its next attack against this target.
